items.title: setCustomer: when a BP with that idMagento already exists, return it or update it? Address wipe? Which BP if several?
items.question: LAN found the existing Cte row and UPDATED it (names, email, and blanked the address) before returning the same account. ServicioSAP today always creates a new BP. Three sub-decisions: (1) return the existing BP only, or also update names/email; (2) replicate the SP's address wipe; (3) tie-break when several BPs share the same ZidMagento.

LAN sends the address columns always empty (CustomerMethods.cs:24-33).
items.ss: BusinessPartnerController.cs:36-66 CreateClient: Build (:46) -> Submit (:47) -> guard (:48-59) -> Ok(result.Partner.Trim()) (:60); no lookup. BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:435 'Partner = ""' (always create); :484 SmtpAddr = correo (uppercase since S4, :397); :579 ZidMagento = idMagentoValue. Duplicate sources: order flow OrderMethods.cs:2827 ZidMagento = info.idMagento (currently 0, G04-29) and unircuenta PATCH BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:779-818 (:794 writes ZidMagento onto an existing BP). BP01 modifies when Partner<>'' but the builder sends ~190 empty fields (RSG_BP01:18-19, :101-102; CHK_BP:248-272): an update needs a partial payload whose shape is not in the repo. Since CQ4=B the BP keeps Street/NameCo, phone, Birthdt, Region JAL, contact 20: a full re-submit or an address wipe would destroy what the user chose to keep.
items.example: idMagento 10555 posts setCustomer twice (profile edit). LAN: both calls return C0001234, second call rewrites names/email and blanks the address. ServicioSAP today: two BPs (15000xxxx1, 15000xxxx2). Tie-break example: sap.log shows BP numbers ascend with time (1500007543 -> 1500007544 -> 1500008276), so 'highest Partner' = newest.

options.what: Lookup by ZidMagento; if found, return its Partner. No update. Several -> highest Partner (newest).
options.consequence: Idempotent setCustomer with no new BP01 payload; S5 is small (orchestrator SetCustomerAsync + GetFilterClientsAsync). Divergence: a profile edit (new name/email) is NOT reflected in SAP; documented as DIF in 1.1-R19.

options.what: a + update NameFirst/NameLast/NameLst2/SmtpAddr with a partial BP01 payload (Partner set, only those fields). No address wipe.
options.consequence: Closest to LAN without destroying CQ4=B data, but the partial BP01 shape is unknown: it needs a DEV test with a throw-away BP and your approval of the exact payload before S5 writes it (plan §4.5 rule). Adds a second SAP call and a second failure branch.

options.what: Replicate the SP update literally, including blanking the address and CP.
options.consequence: Would wipe Street/NameCo/Region on every call: contradicts CQ4=B and the address orders use. Not recommended (never c).

options.what: Keep creating a BP per call and record the difference.
options.consequence: No S5 code; duplicates keep growing (one BP per retry/edit); credit and order flows that read BP05 by ZidMagento get ambiguous rows.

items.recommendation: a for S5 now, with 'highest Partner wins' when several; b as a separate follow-up task only after a DEV capture of a partial BP01 update (or SAP confirms the shape). Never c.
items.how_to_answer: Pick a/b/c/d and confirm the tie-break (highest Partner = newest, or tell me another field; BP05 has no creation date in Partner.cs, Zfecha4 is the last change). Optional evidence for the tie-break and duplicates in LAN (read-only, IntelisisTmp, you run it): SELECT IdMagento, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Cte WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IdMagento > 2 GROUP BY IdMagento HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY n DESC;

items.title: Guests (idMagento 0-2): does Magento still call setCustomer for them, and do they get one BP per email or the fixed guest BP?
items.question: LAN required idMagento + email to match for ids <= 2 (one Cte per guest email). ServicioSAP has no guest rule in setCustomer, and the order flow uses a fixed guest BP. Three BPs already exist in DEV with ZidMagento 0, so a lookup by ZidMagento alone would match them all. Which rule should S5 build for id <= 2?
items.lan: SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:62-68: for @IdCteMagento <= 2 the match needs Idmagento AND eMail1 (one account per guest email); :190-200 updates only Nombre + address for guests; LAN CustomerMethods.cs:74 int.Parse(sntz(idMagento)) accepts 0.
items.ss: BusinessPartnerController.cs:36-66 CreateClient has no guest branch; BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:404 int.Parse(idMagento) accepts 0 and :579 writes ZidMagento 0. Order flow: OrderMethods.cs:41 'private const string GuestCashPartnerNumber = "1500003857"', :2627-2641 ResolveMAPartnerAsync returns it when cuenta and cliente are empty. Evidence: Logs/sap.log has 8 occurrences of "ZidMagento":0 (BPs 1500007543, 1500007544, 1500008276), so 'ZidMagento eq 0' already returns several BPs. Email match would use Partner.cs:189 Mail with the value uppercased like the create (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:397), escaped and URL-encoded like CustomerMethods.cs:82-83 (Replace("'","''") + Uri.EscapeDataString), never changing BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:221.
items.example: Guest checkout, idMagento 0, email ana@x.com, posted twice. LAN: first call creates C0009999, second returns C0009999 (same email). ServicioSAP today: two BPs, both ZidMagento 0. With a lookup by ZidMagento only: returns 1500007543 (someone else's guest BP) for every guest.

options.what: Magento never sends idMagento 0-2 to setCustomer (guests do not reach it).
options.consequence: S5 looks up by ZidMagento only; if an id <= 2 still arrives it is treated as a create like today (or rejected: say which). No Mail filter needed, so the Mail GET of step 0 becomes CQ14-only.

options.what: Guests do reach setCustomer and get one BP per email, like LAN.
options.consequence: S5 builds the LAN rule: id > 2 -> 'ZidMagento eq <id>'; id <= 2 -> 'ZidMagento eq <id> and Mail eq '<EMAIL_UPPER>''. Needs step 0 Mail GREEN and the escape/encode approval (F-01). Guest BPs keep ZidMagento 0 and are distinguished by Mail.

options.what: Guests map to the fixed guest BP of the order flow (OrderMethods.cs:41, 1500003857).
options.consequence: S5 returns the constant for id <= 2 without any SAP call; no guest BP is ever created by setCustomer; names/email of the guest are not stored in SAP (DIF vs LAN). The constant becomes shared by two flows (SKILL 28: should move to one place; needs approval).

items.recommendation: B if Magento confirms it sends guests (strict parity, and it is the only option that avoids returning another guest's BP); A if it does not. C only if the business accepts that guests have no BP of their own.
items.how_to_answer: Ask the Magento/Omnipro owner whether the setCustomer URL is invoked for guest checkout (there is no caller in Magento248 app/code, the URL is admin config: CQ10). Or check LAN data (read-only, IntelisisTmp, you run it): SELECT IdMagento, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(Alta) AS ultimaAlta FROM Cte WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IdMagento BETWEEN 0 AND 2 GROUP BY IdMagento; -- rows with a recent ultimaAlta mean guests still arrive through setCustomer.
items.unblocks: T1.1-03 / S5 (the id <= 2 branch of SetCustomerAsync) and the T1.1-09 case 'invitado id 0 con correo repetido'.

items.title: Approve how S5 escapes and URL-encodes the email inside the BP05 $filter (only if CQ3 = B)
items.question: The S5 rules say: do not touch the shared wrapper (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:221) and ask before writing an escape. Two existing patterns exist; which one may S5 use for the Mail value of the guest lookup?
items.lan: SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:65-66 compares eMail1 as a SQL parameter (no escaping needed); LAN CustomerMethods.cs:184-192 sntz removes & ' : < > " / % ( ) = ? before the SP.
items.ss: Pattern 1: Methods/Customer/CustomerMethods.cs:82-83 ValidarClienteEnSapAsync: valor = correo.Replace("'","''"); filtro = $"{campo} eq '{Uri.EscapeDataString(valor)}'" (already approved via CQ13). Pattern 2: Methods/Order/OrderMethods.cs:2993-2996 private static EscapeSapFilterValue (Trim + Replace("'","''")), private, no URL encoding; reusing it from BusinessPartnerMethods needs it made internal/shared (approval per GUIA 1.9b). Note Sntz already strips ' & % ( ) = ? from the email before the lookup (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:397), so after Sntz only '+', '#' and spaces remain as URL-sensitive characters.
items.example: Email ana+promo@x.com: without encoding, '+' becomes a space in the query string and BP05 answers 'No se encontraron clientes' -> S5 would create a duplicate BP. With Uri.EscapeDataString: Mail eq 'ANA%2BPROMO%40X.COM' matches.

options.what: Inline the CustomerMethods.cs:82-83 pattern inside SetCustomerAsync (Replace + Uri.EscapeDataString on the value only).
options.consequence: No new member, no change to shared code; the same two lines exist in two places (acceptable duplication, same as CQ13).

options.what: Promote OrderMethods.cs:2993 EscapeSapFilterValue to a shared helper (e.g. Methods\Utils) and add encoding there; use it in both places.
options.consequence: One shared escape (SKILL 28) but touches OrderMethods and creates a new member: needs your explicit approval and a separate commit.

items.recommendation: 1 for S5; 2 as a later hygiene task (item 9 of ESTADO §9, 'one shared LiteralOData + Uri.EscapeDataString helper', CQ13).
items.how_to_answer: Reply '1' or '2'. Not needed if CQ3 = A or C (no Mail filter in S5).

ServicioSAP: Curl.PostAsync retries 3 times (30 s each, 2 s + 4 s waits) and then throws; the controller has no try/catch, so the caller gets HTTP 500 after up to ~96 s, and setCuenta is re-sent up to 3 times.
